summary: CQENS Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to existing warrants issued to related party Xten Capital Group in a 2020 asset acquisition. The amendment extends the exercise period of the Series A Warrant from September 2023–2026 to September 2029–2032, and delays the Series B Warrant commencement from September 2026 to September 2029, aligning its expiry with 2032. No new securities, cash, or other consideration were involved. This is a routine contractual modification of outstanding equity derivatives, not a standalone special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is informational only; there are no deal terms, premiums, or board recommendations to assess.
